text: TISSUE DESCRIPTION: Liver segments IV through VIII (1,900 grams; 22 x 14 x 9 cm), liver segment III (15. grams; 4.5 X 3 X 2.7 cm), and biopsy specimen from the peritoneum (1 X 0.8 x 0.4. cm). A1, B1, B2, B3, B4, C1. DIAGNOSIS: Liver, segments IV through VIII, resection: Grade 2 (of 4) hepatocellular. carcinoma, usual type, forming a multinodular mass, 16 x 15 x 11 cm, with multiple. (5) satellite nodules ranging in size from 0.5 cm to 1.5 cm. The tumor is located in. segments IV through VIII. The hepatic capsule is free of tumor. The surgical. margins are free of tumor, the clearance being approximately 1 mm microscopically. Extensive extratumoral vascular invasion is identified. The tumor is not. encapsulated, infiltration of parenchyma being of the infiltrating type. The non-. neoplastic liver will be assessed on permanent sections and an addendum will be. issued. Liver, segment III, excision: Bile duct hamartoma (1.2 x 1.1 x 1 cm). Peritoneum, biopsy: Inflammatory adhesion, negative for tumor. Specimen photographed in lab. PHOTOGRAPHED IN LAB. ADDENDUM: The non-neoplastic liver shows no features of either primary or chronic liver. disease. Seen with Dr.

T.evidence: forming a multinodular mass, 16 x 15 x 11 cm, with multiple. (5) satellite nodules ranging in size from 0.5 cm to 1.5 cm. The tumor is located in. segments IV through VIII. The hepatic capsule is free of tumor. The surgical. margins are free of tumor, the clearance being approximately 1 mm microscopically. Extensive extratumoral vascular invasion is identified.
T.reason: Multiple tumors with a dominant lesion 16 cm (>5 cm) meets criteria for T3 (multiple tumors with at least one >5 cm). Vascular invasion is present but the report does not specify involvement of a major branch of the portal/hepatic vein (which could alter staging), so there is some uncertainty.

N.reason: No regional lymph nodes are described or reported as examined; nodal status cannot be assessed from the report.

M.evidence: Peritoneum, biopsy: Inflammatory adhesion, negative for tumor.
M.reason: No distant metastasis identified in the submitted peritoneal biopsy and no other metastatic sites reported; however only limited distant sampling was performed, so assessment is not comprehensive.
